includes: Authoritative State with PostgreSQL and Garage
NixOS wiring, migration, rollback, and QEMU qualification
preserves: immutable V2.0.1 semantics and public habitat names
Garage behind the S3-compatible evidence seam

modules.name: Authority and Effects
modules.interface: Authenticated invocations enter one default-deny decision and durable effect lifecycle used by production and tests.
modules.seam: Authenticated transport hands complete invocations to authority and admitted proposals to effects.
invariants: provider acknowledgement alone never proves completion
production and adversarial tests cross the same interface
modules.test_surface: The deployed interface with real authority/effects implementations and substitutable adapters.

modules.name: Authoritative State
modules.interface: Domain transactions commit objectives, wakes, activations, leases, replay, effects, packages, governed change, and evidence references atomically.
modules.seam: Domain callers submit complete transitions; storage and transport remain internal.
invariants: PostgreSQL is the sole operational truth
evidence is content addressed and independently verified
stale fences and versions fail closed
modules.test_surface: The same transaction interface used by deployed runtime callers.

modules.name: Runtime Coordination
modules.interface: A durable objective advances or recovers without callers knowing roles, protocol ordering, response tokens, or filesystem conventions.
modules.seam: Role transports adapt deployed processes to one coordination interface.
invariants: coordination never bypasses state or authority
modules.test_surface: Objective progression and interruption recovery through the production interface.

modules.name: Attested Qualification Run
modules.interface: A caller requests complete qualification and receives digest-bound observations and artifacts or a fail-closed result.
modules.seam: Execution is substitutable internally while evidence meaning and verification remain fixed.
invariants: artifacts bind command, source, closure, and digest
release evidence comes from the exact tree
modules.test_surface: Complete attested runs through the production release interface.

requirements.shall: Every deployed authority decision crosses MOD-AUTHORITY-EFFECTS; unconditional authorization is absent.
requirements.acceptance: Unauthorized and expired invocations are denied through the deployed entrypoint.

requirements.shall: Every external effect crosses durable admission, attempt recording, reconciliation, and independent completion.
requirements.acceptance: No unledgered dispatch, duplicate execution, blind retry, or premature completion.

requirements.shall: One Authoritative State interface owns every production state transition.
requirements.acceptance: No caller selects among competing state owners.

requirements.shall: Replay, transitions, fences, versions, and evidence references commit atomically and recover fail closed.
requirements.acceptance: Crash, stale fence/version, migration, and restore preserve invariants.

requirements.shall: Garage behavior remains behind the S3-compatible adapter and PostgreSQL remains authoritative.
MOD-RUNTIME owns objective progression, dependency readiness, and recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Production and tests use the same coordination interface.

requirements.shall: Role and wire protocols remain in transport adapters.
requirements.acceptance: Two adapters pass one conformance suite without changing MOD-RUNTIME.

requirements.shall: Work-packet and release qualification use one Attested Qualification Run implementation.
requirements.acceptance: Callers share hashing, execution, attestation, and verification.

requirements.shall: Synthetic, stale, inherited, and tree-mismatched evidence fails closed.
requirements.acceptance: Forbidden evidence fails and fresh exact-tree evidence passes.

requirements.shall: NixOS production units invoke only the deep modules and prove live readiness dependencies.
requirements.acceptance: No bypass entrypoint; readiness requires PostgreSQL, Garage, authority, effects, and coordination.

requirements.shall: Upgrade and rollback preserve durable state without lost work or duplicate effects.
requirements.acceptance: State, evidence, fences, replay, and exactly-once outcomes survive upgrade and rollback.

requirements.shall: Qualify the complete production path from one clean exact tree and closure in fresh QEMU.
requirements.acceptance: Every gate passes from fresh non-synthetic evidence bound to one source and closure.

verification_gates.claim: V2.1.0 is valid, acyclic, content addressed, and preserves V2.0.1.
verification_gates.pass_condition: All validations pass and V2.0.1 is unchanged.

verification_gates.claim: Authoritative State is singular, atomic, recoverable, and verifies evidence.
The deployed path uses default-deny authority and durable effects.
verification_gates.pass_condition: ARCH-001 and ARCH-002 pass without bypass.

verification_gates.claim: Runtime Coordination owns progression and recovery behind adapter seams.
One Attested Qualification Run produces and verifies all evidence.
NixOS deploys only conforming modules with governed migration and rollback.
verification_gates.pass_condition: DEPLOY-001 and MIG-001 pass in a fresh image.

verification_gates.claim: The complete production outcome is proven from the exact tree and closure.
verification_gates.pass_condition: Every prior gate passes and QEMU proves interruption recovery without lost work or duplicate effects.
